entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A desert plane ruled by Nicol Bolas, whose society trains warriors for the Trials of the Five Gods and is centered around death.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who rules Amonkhet and whose return the inhabitants prepare for as the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that arrives on Amonkhet to take out Bolas.

entities.name: Trials of the Five Gods
entities.description: The trials the inhabitants train for to join the elite Worthy and claim a place in the Afterlife.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who shares an exchange with Nissa in the story.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who shares an exchange with Chandra in the story.

events.summary: The inhabitants of Amonkhet train all their lives for the Trials of the Five Gods and prepare for the God-Pharaoh's return.
events.quote: They train their entire life for a chance to face the Trials of the Five Gods and join the elite ranks of the Worthy

events.summary: The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas and meets fierce resistance in the desert and the city.
events.quote: When The Gatewatch arrives to take out Bolas, they meet with fierce resistance in the desert

relations.note: the plane is ruled by Bolas
relations.quote: Amonkhet is a plane ruled by Nicol Bolas .
